hint_2: A brilliant producer panic-cries on schedule, a neurotic reporter actually knows what he's doing, and a handsome anchor becomes the human embodiment of lowering standards with a nice smile.
hint_3: This is the part where I stop being polite about it. It's a love triangle in a TV newsroom, and the sexiest character trait on offer is professional competence.
hint_4: Jane, Tom, Aaron. One makes the show work, one knows the truth, one looks perfect saying it. The title is two words: transmit, then the thing anchors used to claim they served.

title: Brokeback Mountain
hint_1: A 2005 romantic drama that took the wide-open American West and made it feel like the smallest, loneliest place two people could be trapped.
hint_2: Two ranch hands spend a summer herding sheep, fall in love, and then spend years pretending the rest of their lives can survive that fact. Spoiler: pretending is not a treatment plan.
hint_3: I'm going to need you to search your memory more aggressively. Wyoming, denim, silence, longing, two shirts hanging together, and one sentence about not knowing how to quit somebody.
hint_4: Ennis and Jack. A forbidden love story named after the place they return to in memory, desire, and ruin. The title is the location that becomes the wound.
